t: The boy who tested which one was true
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ أَمْرُ الرَّاهِبِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ أَمْرِ السَّاحِرِ فَاقْتُلْ هَذِهِ الدَّابَّةَ حَتَّى يَمْضِيَ النَّاسُ
p: Allāhumma in kāna amru-r-rāhibi aḥabba ilayka min amri-s-sāḥiri fa-qtul hādhihi-d-dābbata ḥattā yamḍiya-n-nās
m: O Allah, if the monk's way is more beloved to You than the magician's way, then kill this animal so the people can pass.
